en.headline: Luxury Festival of Connoisseurs slated for November debut
en.dek: Informa Markets and the Hong Kong Tourism Board plan the first Festival of Connoisseurs this November, with a larger edition scheduled for 2027.
body: Event organiser Informa Markets and the Hong Kong Tourism Board have scheduled the first Festival of Connoisseurs in Hong Kong for November 2026, under a partnership announced earlier this year.

Informa Markets said in May that it had signed a memorandum of understanding with the Tourism Board, which became the first strategic partner for the project. The organiser described the 2026 edition as a soft launch ahead of a fuller festival in 2027, built around a "city-as-your-showroom" format that would use more than one venue.

The planned programme is organised as nine "worlds of connoisseurship", covering areas the organiser listed as marina, marque, vault, galerie, passage, estate, zenith, vitalis and culinaire. Informa Markets said the platform draws on its other luxury events, including boat and supercar shows overseas.

Local reports this week said the inaugural edition would use AsiaWorld-Expo near the airport as the main venue from 4 to 6 November, with other elements around the city. RTHK reported on Thursday that officials were promoting the festival as part of efforts to draw high-spending visitors and larger exhibitions.

zh.headline: 鑑賞家盛典擬11月首辦
zh.dek: Informa Markets與旅發局計劃今年11月在港首辦「鑑賞家盛典」，2027年再擴大規模。
body: 活動主辦機構Informa Markets與香港旅遊發展局，按今年較早前公布的合作安排，擬於2026年11月在香港首辦「鑑賞家盛典」（Festival of Connoisseurs）。
Informa Markets 5月公布與旅發局簽署合作備忘錄，旅發局成為項目首個策略夥伴。主辦單位形容2026年為試辦，2027年再辦更大規模活動，並採用「全城即展場」形式，不限於單一場地。
策劃內容分為九個「鑑賞世界」，主辦單位列出包括船舶、汽車、珠寶收藏、藝廊、時尚、房地產、航空、健康及餐飲等範疇，並指會借用其海外豪華展覽經驗。
本港近日報道指，首屆活動擬以機場附近的亞洲國際博覽館為主要場地，日期為11月4至6日，並在其他地點設延伸項目。港台星期四報道，當局將活動視為吸引高消費旅客及大型展覽的一部分。
